summary: Starward Whisky is a Port Melbourne whisky distillery that returned to founder David Vitale's ownership after buying out Diageo in January 2026. Indra Miklavc has been Financial Controller since June 2025. LinkedIn shows headcount of 20-30, down 30% YoY, with staff in five countries.

Indra's process-improvement background makes her a receptive, practical evaluator.

first.subject: Closing the books after Diageo at Starward
first.body:
Hi Indra,

You joined Starward as Financial Controller in June 2025 and have since seen founder David Vitale buy the business back from Diageo. With a workforce spread across five countries, the close probably carries distributor and export receipts that are hard to match by hand. You've rebuilt a chart of accounts and led process improvements before, so I'd value your view. I'm building Vert, which reconciles and cash codes with a traceable audit trail instead of guessing, turning hours into minutes. Where does month-end at Starward still lean on spreadsheets?

Best,
